title: vl04: 'Die Vektoren des Hilbertraums beschreiben die Zustaende' contradicts the course (states are density operators)

legacy.old_text: Die Vektoren des Hilbertraums beschreiben die Zustände eines Systems, die Operatoren seine Observablen
legacy.new_text: Das zweite Standbein der Theorie sind die Operatoren: Mit ihnen beschreibt die Quantenmechanik Zustände, Messungen und Dynamik.
legacy.applied_text: Mit ihnen beschreibt die Quantenmechanik Zustände, Messungen und Dynamik

legacy.old_text: The vectors of the Hilbert space describe the states of a system, the operators its observables
legacy.new_text: The second pillar of the theory is the operators: with them quantum mechanics describes states, measurements and dynamics.
legacy.applied_text: with them quantum mechanics describes states, measurements and dynamics

reason: vl04.tex:5 says the vectors of the Hilbert space describe the states of a system. In the course the states are the density operators (positive, trace one, D22); a vector describes a pure state only through its projector (c03.s1 says so). Hazard H3.2 of the curriculum report. The same sentence stood in vl03:254, the opening of the subsection that moved to vl04. The new text attributes states, measurements and dynamics to the operators and does not call a vector a state.
